svg.title: The Poisson failure floor
svg.desc: Exact Poisson probability that a feature collects at most half its mean count, on a log axis from 1 to 1e-15, versus the mean from 10 to 1000: 1e-9 needs a mean of about 122, 1e-12 about 166; vertical markers at 110, 209, 280 and 533 absorbed photons from the page's example.
